name: io.github.WYRE-AI/action1-mcp
title: Action1
description: Action1 MCP server — endpoint inventory, patch visibility, and policy automation via REST API.

environmentVariables.name: ACTION1_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Action1 API key — the client_id of an API key created under Settings → API & Integrations.

environmentVariables.name: ACTION1_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Action1 API secret — the client_secret paired with ACTION1_API_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: ACTION1_REGION
environmentVariables.description: Action1 hosting region, which selects the API host: NorthAmerica (app.action1.com), Europe (app.eu.action1.com), AsiaPacific (app.ap.action1.com), or Australia (app.au.action1.com).

environmentVariables.name: ACTION1_DEFAULT_ORG_ID
environmentVariables.description: Organization id used when a tool call omits organization_id. Leave unset to require it explicitly on every call.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
